content: eBay DVD item specifics buyers filter on: Format (DVD/Blu-ray/4K), Region Code, Edition (Widescreen, Collector's, Criterion, Director's Cut, Extended, n-Disc Set), Rating (MPAA), Condition (Brand New/Like New/Very Good/Good/Acceptable). Sellers advised: honest condition, note missing inserts/slipcover, original case matters, bundles (trilogies/genre lots), complete seasons and boutique editions hold value.
